Verified Gold Coast testimonials are added as they are collected. Frequently asked Common kitchen renovation questions on the Gold Coast How much does a kitchen renovation cost on the Gold Coast? As a guide, a budget refresh runs about $12,000 to $30,000, a mid-range full renovation about $25,000 to $60,000, and premium or waterfront builds $45,000 to $94,000 or more. Your QBCC-licensed builder gives you a fixed-price written quote after a free in-home consult. What drives the cost of a Gold Coast kitchen renovation up or down? The main cost drivers are cabinetry quantity and finish (laminate versus 2-pac), benchtop material, whether the layout and plumbing move, appliance grade, and access on high-rise or canal-front sites. Labour is roughly 30 to 40 percent of the total. How much does a premium or waterfront kitchen renovation cost on the Gold Coast? Premium and waterfront kitchen renovations in canal-front and prestige homes generally start around $45,000 and run to $94,000 or more, reflecting custom joinery, natural stone, integrated appliances and butler's pantry additions. How long does a kitchen renovation take on the Gold Coast? A standard mid-range kitchen renovation usually takes 6 to 12 weeks from contract signing to handover: 4 to 6 weeks of cabinetry and stone fabrication lead-in, then 2 to 4 weeks of on-site work plus finishing. How long is the workmanship warranty on a kitchen renovation? Most reputable Gold Coast renovators offer 5 to 10 years on workmanship and custom cabinetry. The QBCC scheme also provides statutory cover of 6 years 6 months for structural and 12 months for non-structural defects.
